snippet.title: Tower Inc Trailer – Survival Horror in a Twisted Corporate Tower
snippet.description:
Enter the nightmare of Tower Inc.
Explore endless shifting floors, outsmart deadly traps, and survive the monsters that stalk you in the dark.
Can you make it out alive?

Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2261310/Tower_Inc/ 
or
https://rotogames.itch.io/tower-inc
